label: kizuna_health_d_01
text: Hey there! Come on in! Everyone’s welcome in\nthe nurse’s office![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_d_03
text: I have some good news! You’re not gonna\nbelieve this, but...[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_d_04
text: I passed the health teacher certification exam![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_d_06
text: I saw you pushing yourself real hard with your\nTreasure Hunt, and that really inspired me.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_d_07
text: Of course, MOST of the credit for my success\ngoes to my own hard work, though! Hehe.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_d_08
text: Thanks for giving me the push I needed to try\nagain, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_d_09
text: Buuut they tell me there’s no room to add new\nclasses this year![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_d_10
text: So I guess I’ll keep being Nurse Miriam for a bit![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_d_11
text: Just you wait, though! I’ll be standing in front of\na class at this academy before you know it.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_d_12
text: Then I’ll teach you all you need to know\nabout health![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_d_13
text: I bet I’ll make a great teacher. I can’t wait to see\nyou in my class![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_d_system_01
text: You formed a close bond with Nurse Miriam!
